results.name: Valorstones
results.pinDescription: Earned from completing quests, raids, dungeons, battlegrounds, arena matches, radiant echoes, and other activities at max level. Used to upgrade max-level gear.

results.name: Valorstones in The War Within Overview Guide - How to Earn and Spend Valorstones
results.pinDescription: This guide is a complete overview of the Valorstones currency in The War Within including what they are, how to earn them, and where to spend them.

results.name: The Better Part of Valorstones
results.pinDescription:
It's been many months since we arrived in Dornogal and there's still more to learn of Valorstones. It turns out they can be found beyond Azeroth! This discovery opens up entirely new avenues of research.

With new research comes a need for new supplies. Bring me some, and we'll help upgrade your gear to new heights.

results.name: Gear Item Level Upgrade System for The War Within: Valorstones and Crests
results.pinDescription: Learn about the gear upgrade system for The War Within expansion. This system covers everything about Valorstones and Crests and how to use them to increase the item levels of endgame gear!

news.name: Upgrading Gear on Midnight Beta Now Costs Gold Instead of Valorstones
news.pinDescription: Upgrading Gear on the Midnight Beta now costs gold in addition to crests.

news.name: Valorstones Remain Until Full Midnight Launch
news.pinDescription: Valorstones are sticking around until the full expansion launches in March, but they can now be transferred between characters!

news.name: Valorstones Removed in Midnight
news.pinDescription: With many players expressing grievances with Valorstones in previous expansions, Blizzard has announced that Valorstones will be removed with the Midnight expansion.

news.name: Midnight Developer Q&A Liveblog - Valorstones Removed in Midnight
news.pinDescription: The Midnight Q&A begins now! Follow along with our liveblog as Game Director Ion Hazzikostas, Associate Game Director Paul Kubit, and Design Director Maria Hamilton answer your biggest questions about Midnight.

news.name: Last Chance to Funnel Valorstones - Transfer Disabled with Patch 11.2
news.pinDescription: With Patch 11.2 launching this week, Blizzard will be disabling the ability to transfer [currency=3008] between characters in the same account. Note that, unlike previous seasons, Valorstones will not reset with the arrival of the new patch.

news.name: Valorstones No Longer Reset With New Seasons in Patch 11.2: Ghosts of K'aresh
news.pinDescription: A nice quality of life change revealed in this week's Patch 11.2 PTR Development Notes is that Valorstones will no longer reset at the start of a new season, so start stockpiling now!

news.name: Delver's Bounty Turbo Boost Buffs - More Gilded Crests and Valorstones, Massive Brann Experience
news.pinDescription: The Hidden Trove rewards from Delver's Bounty maps have received significant buffs in the Turbo Boost event, including more Gilded Crests, a lot of Valorstones, and a Big Wheel of Cheese!

news.name: Turbo Boost: Valorstones Become Warbound-Transferrable at 25% Penalty
news.pinDescription: With the Turbo Boost coming on May 13th, Valorstones will become Warbound-transferrable for the remainder of Season Two... though with the premium price of a 25% penalty on the transferred currency.

news.name: Last Day to Spend Season 1 Crests and Valorstones Before Reset
news.pinDescription: With Patch 11.1 launching tomorrow, today is the last day to spend your Season 1 Crests and Valorstones before they likely reset!

news.name: C.H.E.T.T. - Earn Valorstones from Tasks around Undermine
news.pinDescription: Undermine(d) introduces a neat way for players to earn extra Valorstones with C.H.E.T.T. Here is everything players need to know about this new system.

news.name: Rewards for Defeating Zekvir in His Lair - Cosmetics, Valorstones Farm
news.pinDescription: With players earning more gear in Season 1 of The War Within, the interest in challenging Zekvir, the final challenge of Delves, is increasing. In this post, we highlight all rewards for killing Zekvir, and even a potential reason to continuously farm him!

news.name: Wax Farming for Valorstones - Prepping for Season 1 Launch
news.pinDescription: Prepare for Season 1 by stocking up on Globs of Wax allowing you to bypass the normal cap of Valorstones!
